assets/work/project-liftoff.jpg.idea: I wanted joining a student club to feel like signing up for a launch. A Saturn V cuts diagonally across black, cream orbit lines and an orange sun, with the theme explained in small type like a mission brief.
assets/work/project-liftoff.jpg.alt: A Saturn V rocket angled across a black poster with cream concentric lines, an orange sun and the title Project: Liftoff.

assets/work/recruitment-calendar.jpg.idea: This had to get one action: scan the code. A small rocket lifts off in front of a huge orange sun and the QR code sits right in the exhaust cloud, where the eye lands.
assets/work/recruitment-calendar.jpg.alt: A rocket launching in front of concentric orange sun rings with the title Recruitment Calendar Spring 2026 and a QR code.

assets/work/info-night.jpg.idea: I wanted a first-year to feel the size of what they could walk into. One tiny figure stands under a sweeping concrete structure, and the only line of copy says don't build alone.
assets/work/info-night.jpg.alt: A lone person dwarfed by a curved concrete overpass at night, with the title Info Night and event details.

assets/work/launchpoint-redbull.jpg.idea: The job was to get people to the lawn early. The Red Bull can becomes the rocket, flames out the bottom, and a gold ticket promises a free one to the first arrivals.
assets/work/launchpoint-redbull.jpg.alt: A Red Bull can with rocket flames beneath the Launch Point logo and a gold ticket reading Free Red Bull.

assets/work/general-body-meeting.jpg.idea: A general meeting is the dullest event on a club calendar, so I billed it like a gathering at the Colosseum. Copperplate script, corner flourishes and a watercolour amphitheatre treat it with a straight face.
assets/work/general-body-meeting.jpg.alt: A watercolour Colosseum on cream with ornate corner flourishes and General Body Meeting in script.

assets/work/matcha-social.jpg.idea: The joke is one object in the wrong century. Michelangelo's David holds an iced matcha inside a gilt frame, which tells you the event is free drinks and not too serious.
assets/work/matcha-social.jpg.alt: The statue of David holding an iced matcha drink inside a tilted ornate picture frame, with event details around it.

assets/work/partnership.jpg.idea: Two organisations meeting needed a picture everyone already knows. The hands from the Creation of Adam reach toward each other and the two logos sit in the gap between the fingers.
assets/work/partnership.jpg.alt: The two reaching hands from Michelangelo's Creation of Adam with the Startup Incubator and Transpose Platform logos between them.

assets/work/mini-hackathon.jpg.idea: I wanted a mandatory event to feel like a prize. A painted crown is being lowered onto a head in near darkness, with the title in red serif above it.
assets/work/mini-hackathon.jpg.alt: Hands lowering a jewelled crown onto a head against a black background, under the title Mini Hackathon in red.

assets/work/pitch-night.jpg.idea: Pitching is standing in front of a crowd that will judge you, so I put the event inside a painted Roman arena. The glowing title sits where the fighter would stand.
assets/work/pitch-night.jpg.alt: A painting of a crowded Roman arena with the glowing title Pitch Night centred over it.

assets/work/mafia-social.jpg.idea: A party game night needed suspicion in one image. A crowd of suited noir figures is cut to the outline of a man in a fedora, and the copy promises quiet alliances.
assets/work/mafia-social.jpg.alt: Illustrated men and women in 1940s suits arranged inside the silhouette of a man in a fedora, beside the title Mafia Social.

assets/work/compiled-16.jpg.idea: The theme was interfaces you cannot see, so the hero is a person turning into signal. A silhouette breaks into scan lines over a heat-map field, framed on cream like a gallery print.
assets/work/compiled-16.jpg.alt: A cream poster with a dark human silhouette dissolving into blue and red interference patterns, titled c0mpiled-16 Hackathon, Invisible Interfaces.

assets/work/compiled-5.jpg.idea: I wanted future interfaces to feel like first contact. A green wireframe hand reaches out of an old computer to touch a real finger, a Creation of Adam restaged with a spark at the fingertip.
assets/work/compiled-5.jpg.alt: A green wireframe hand reaching from a computer to touch a human fingertip with a spark, beside red terminal-style hackathon titles.

assets/work/bow-capital.jpg.idea: A defense theme needed tension without showing a weapon. I laid targeting brackets and HUD ticks over aerial farmland in mismatched green tiles, with the title spaced out like coordinates.
assets/work/bow-capital.jpg.alt: Tiled green aerial photographs with yellow targeting marks and widely spaced text reading Bow Capital Hackathon, Theme: Defense.

assets/work/datahacks.jpg.idea: The entrepreneurship track is about one idea getting noticed. A single lit bulb floats in white space under the line Shine a Light on Your Idea, with gold italics for the track name.
assets/work/datahacks.jpg.alt: A single glowing light bulb on a cream background above the text DataHacks 2026 Entrepreneurship Track.

assets/reels/c16-invisible.mp4.idea: I wanted viewers to hear what was actually being built. Each team explains its project in its own words on the hackathon floor, with a purple pill naming the idea in five words or fewer.
assets/reels/c16-invisible.mp4.alt: Vertical reel of hackathon participants explaining their projects, each shot labelled with a purple caption pill.

assets/reels/c16-mosaic.mp4.idea: The point was that a hackathon is its people. One portrait pulls back into a wall of hundreds of faces that forms the poster's silhouette, then cuts to the poster itself.
assets/reels/c16-mosaic.mp4.alt: A single portrait zooming out into a mosaic of hundreds of faces, ending on the c0mpiled-16 hackathon poster.

assets/reels/c16-four-hours.mp4.idea: I wanted the finished demo to feel earned. The film opens on the result, then a card reads This is them four hours earlier, and it cuts back to a screen mid-build and a timestamp.
assets/reels/c16-four-hours.mp4.alt: A title card reading This is them four hours earlier, followed by footage of a laptop screen and a presenter on a stage.

assets/work/salesathon.jpg.idea: A sales contest is about getting a door to open. I filled the frame with one red door and set the title in heavy italic caps that feel like a knock.
assets/work/salesathon.jpg.alt: A red panelled door filling the frame with the title Sales-a-thon and the line Trade your way up to a sales internship.

assets/work/networking-night.jpg.idea: The sponsor had to be present without the poster becoming an ad. I shot the can tab as a black-and-white macro with condensation, so you see the bull before you read the red logo.
devices: black and white with one red
assets/work/networking-night.jpg.alt: A black-and-white close-up of a wet Red Bull can tab with the title Networking Night in tall serif capitals.

assets/work/voiceos-fireside.jpg.idea: A voice product needed a face and a sound. The speaker's halftone portrait sits against a blue waveform, and the background heats from yellow to red like a fire.
assets/work/voiceos-fireside.jpg.alt: A halftone portrait of a man in a suit over a waveform on a yellow-to-red gradient, titled VoiceOS Fireside Chat with Alex Goldstone.

assets/reels/nn-recap.mp4.idea: The recap had to prove who was in the room. Speakers get name-and-title lower thirds in condensed caps, and one wide shot of the crowd carries the line Founders. Investors. One room.
assets/reels/nn-recap.mp4.alt: Event footage of speakers and a crowded classroom with white condensed captions naming each speaker.

assets/reels/potluck-invite.mp4.idea: I wanted the invite to feel written to one person. A pen writes the invitation by hand, the words lift off the page into a night drive, and it ends on a silhouette at dusk with Dont be late.
assets/reels/potluck-invite.mp4.alt: A hand writing an invitation in ink, a car dashboard at night and a silhouetted figure at dusk with the words Dont be late.

assets/reels/potluck-recap.mp4.idea: I let the guests tell it instead of writing a voiceover. Their real sentences run as captions over close shots of name tags, plates and a cooler of punch.
assets/reels/potluck-recap.mp4.alt: Vertical reel of students talking at an indoor social, with captions and close-ups including an orange drinks cooler.

assets/reels/podcast-arjun.mp4.idea: The clip had to hold on one story. It opens on an off-white card in bold grotesk, The guy next to me., then keeps the speaker in a narrow band while single words rise and sink around him.
assets/reels/podcast-arjun.mp4.alt: An off-white title card reading The guy next to me, followed by a horizontal strip of video on black with animated words.

assets/reels/voiceos.mp4.idea: I wanted to show the product doing a chore in real time. A spoken request turns an emailed poster into a calendar event and a text, then the screen goes black and asks Can your AI do this?
assets/reels/voiceos.mp4.alt: Screen recording of an email with an event poster being turned into a calendar entry and message, ending on the text Can your AI do this?

assets/reels/jw-christmas.mp4.idea: The hotel needed families to picture themselves there. It starts with a drone over candy-cane arches, moves in on a gingerbread roof, and ends at eye level with a child in a Santa hat.
assets/reels/jw-christmas.mp4.alt: Aerial view of a hotel lawn with candy-cane arches, a gingerbread house close-up and a family in Santa hats.

assets/reels/fairfield-wedding.mp4.idea: A venue film sells the night before any guest arrives. I shot the empty lawn through strings of lights and red drapes so the foreground glows, and held the logo for the end.
assets/reels/fairfield-wedding.mp4.alt: Night footage of an outdoor wedding setup with red drapes, chandeliers and string lights, ending on the Fairfield by Marriott logo.

assets/reels/dira-red-saree.mp4.idea: The saree had to be the only red thing in frame. The model stands against pale walls behind out-of-focus leaves, then the camera goes close on the gold weave and the drape from behind.
assets/reels/dira-red-saree.mp4.alt: A woman in a red and gold saree photographed through green leaves, in close-up and from behind, ending on the Dira logo.

assets/reels/eera.mp4.idea: Small jewellery needs the viewer to lean in. Every shot is a macro on skin, a pearl at the collarbone or a stud at the ear, with focus sliding from a lily to her face.
assets/reels/eera.mp4.alt: Close-ups of a pearl pendant and a stud earring on a woman, and a white lily in front of her face, ending on the eera logo.

assets/reels/kapoor.mp4.idea: Gold reads richest in the dark. A choker and earrings rest on deep green velvet and the camera drifts over them slowly, letting the light move across the metal.
assets/reels/kapoor.mp4.alt: A gold choker necklace and matching earrings on dark green velvet, ending on the Kapoor Jewellers logo on black.

assets/reels/solar-subsidy.mp4.idea: A government subsidy had to make sense to a homeowner in under half a minute. Flat characters talk outside a house with a rooftop panel, then two emblems show two amounts that add into one figure.
assets/reels/solar-subsidy.mp4.alt: Flat animation of an official and a resident outside a house with a solar panel, followed by two government emblems with rupee amounts and a total.

assets/reels/bni-lohri.mp4.idea: A festival greeting still had to say what the client does. The Lohri bonfire becomes the O of the word, and business icons circle it like people around the fire.
assets/reels/bni-lohri.mp4.alt: Animated greeting on red where a bonfire ringed with small icons forms the O in Happy Lohri, with the BNI logo.

assets/work/bni-new-year.jpg.idea: A networking group sells luck you make yourself. The year sits on a gold slot machine with the last digit rolling from 3 to 4 under the line Win big this year.
assets/work/bni-new-year.jpg.alt: A gold slot machine showing 2024 with fireworks behind it on a red background and the text Win Big This Year With BNI.

assets/work/air-india-box.jpg.idea: I wanted a snack box people would read before opening. The Maharaja holds court over a biryani in nine comic panels, so the lid tells a joke with the meal as punchline.
assets/work/air-india-box.jpg.alt: A nine-panel comic strip of a turbaned Maharaja character judging dishes, titled Meal Fit for a Maharaja, The Biryani Court.

assets/work/air-india-mockup.jpg.idea: The mockup tests whether the story holds up at tray-table size. The comic sits inside the open lid, directly above the food it is about.
assets/work/air-india-mockup.jpg.alt: An open meal box with a comic strip printed inside the lid and compartments of food below, in warm light.

assets/work/dor-orientation.jpg.idea: An invitation from a nonprofit should show who it is for. The students' group photo takes the top half, framed by an orange lattice border, with partner logos lined up at the bottom.
assets/work/dor-orientation.jpg.alt: An invitation with a group photo of students in navy shirts, a patterned orange border and details for Dor Foundation's 2024 Freshman Orientation Day.

assets/reels/dor-fifth-year.mp4.idea: Five years had to feel like many people, not one logo. It opens on orange text over a firework on black, then fills the screen with collages of ceremonies, classrooms and students.
assets/reels/dor-fifth-year.mp4.alt: A black card with orange text marking Dor's fifth anniversary, followed by collages of photographs of students and events.

assets/work/photo-ridge.jpg.idea: The figure is in shadow while the hills behind him fade into blue haze.
assets/work/photo-ridge.jpg.alt: A person standing on a scrubby ridge in shadow with hazy blue mountains and clear sky behind.

assets/photos/photo-01.jpg.idea: He is standing as still as the figures in the frieze he is looking at.
assets/photos/photo-01.jpg.alt: A person seen from behind in a dim gallery facing a long framed frieze painting.

assets/photos/photo-02.jpg.idea: Red reflections smear across the glass until the building behind turns into a grid.
assets/photos/photo-02.jpg.alt: Blurred red and orange reflections on a car window with a gridded building facade behind.

assets/photos/photo-03.jpg.idea: The roads read as lines of light under a sky with no detail at all.
assets/photos/photo-03.jpg.alt: A city at night seen from above, with lit roads and buildings under a dark sky.

assets/photos/photo-04.jpg.idea: From below, the shade becomes a bowl of light with the bulb as a white dot.
assets/photos/photo-04.jpg.alt: A lit lamp shade photographed from underneath, showing a round white bulb and a woven pattern.

assets/photos/photo-05.jpg.idea: Rain darkened the base of each white column and left the floor like a mirror.
assets/photos/photo-05.jpg.alt: Three tall white columns on a wet stone terrace with greenery and buildings beyond.

assets/photos/photo-06.jpg.idea: One horse, small and far off, framed by a gap in the trees.
assets/photos/photo-06.jpg.alt: A horse grazing in a field seen through tree trunks and branches behind a wooden fence.

assets/photos/photo-07.jpg.idea: The dark car interior works as a mask, leaving only the mirror in the light.
assets/photos/photo-07.jpg.alt: A car wing mirror seen through a dark, irregular opening from inside the vehicle.

assets/photos/photo-08.jpg.alt: A large monochrome drawing of two women and two children in a heavy dark wooden frame on a dim gallery wall.

assets/photos/photo-09.jpg.alt: An ornate white octagonal ceiling above deep red gallery walls, a black marble doorway and two gilt-framed paintings.

assets/photos/photo-10.jpg.idea: My own shadow fell across the bonnet around the badge.
assets/photos/photo-10.jpg.alt: A Porsche crest on a blue car bonnet with the photographer's shadow across it.

assets/photos/photo-11.jpg.idea: White cafe chairs wait empty in front of a gothic house.
assets/photos/photo-11.jpg.alt: A gothic stone manor behind trees with white tables and chairs on a terrace in the foreground.

assets/photos/photo-12.jpg.idea: The sun was hidden behind one cloud, lighting only its edge.
assets/photos/photo-12.jpg.alt: Dark clouds with a bright edge of sunlight seen through a car window beside a building.

assets/photos/photo-13.jpg.alt: A black-painted pub with awnings and pavement tables, seen from inside a car, with a person seated outside.

assets/photos/photo-14.jpg.idea: The lamp throws a fan of light up the wall of an almost empty room.
assets/photos/photo-14.jpg.alt: A tall floor lamp casting warm light up a grey wall beside a bare mattress.

assets/photos/photo-15.jpg.idea: Only the shadows of the group are in the picture, stretched across the pavement.
assets/photos/photo-15.jpg.alt: Long shadows of several people cast on pale pavement.

assets/photos/photo-16.jpg.alt: A large white observation wheel beside a river under blue sky and clouds, with a street lamp in the foreground.

assets/photos/photo-17.jpg.idea: The curve of the white chair leg is repeated by its shadow on the grass.
assets/photos/photo-17.jpg.alt: The bent white metal leg of a garden chair on grass with strong shadows.

assets/photos/photo-18.jpg.idea: A clean glass front is set into a facade stained by years of rain.
assets/photos/photo-18.jpg.alt: A weathered white building with stained pillars and a tall glass entrance under an overcast sky.

assets/photos/photo-19.jpg.idea: Two pairs of hands, one hennaed, are working on a single knot.
assets/photos/photo-19.jpg.alt: Close-up of hands with henna and bangles tying a thread around another person's wrist.

assets/photos/photo-20.jpg.idea: Five orange glasses meet in the middle of the frame.
assets/photos/photo-20.jpg.alt: Several arms raising martini glasses of orange drinks together in a bar.

assets/photos/photo-21.jpg.alt: A dim panelled hall with a pointed glazed arch and open double doors leading out to bright daylight.

assets/photos/photo-22.jpg.idea: A passenger's profile is a pure silhouette against the street.
assets/photos/photo-22.jpg.alt: The silhouette of a passenger inside a cab with a brick building and shopfront visible through the window.

assets/photos/photo-23.jpg.idea: An old green car is parked in front of a Victorian glasshouse.
assets/photos/photo-23.jpg.alt: A vintage green car on a drive beside stone buildings and a domed glasshouse.

assets/photos/photo-24.jpg.idea: The ridges of the corduroy run toward the lens like ploughed land.
assets/photos/photo-24.jpg.alt: Extreme close-up of ribbed corduroy fabric with a blurred background.

assets/photos/photo-25.jpg.idea: The orange sign is the only readable thing in the dark.
assets/photos/photo-25.jpg.alt: A lit Marriott sign on a tower at night with city lights behind.

assets/photos/photo-26.jpg.idea: I caught myself with the camera in a wing mirror at speed.
assets/photos/photo-26.jpg.alt: The photographer holding a camera reflected in a car wing mirror, with blurred greenery behind.

assets/photos/photo-27.jpg.idea: A trench coat and a road that leads straight to the house.
assets/photos/photo-27.jpg.alt: A man in a beige trench coat seen from behind walking along a road toward a stone manor.

assets/work/circulate-street-night.jpg.idea: I wanted to know how the towers feel from the pavement. The camera looks straight up so the lit bands of the facade become stripes against a dark sky.
assets/work/circulate-street-night.jpg.alt: A 3D render looking up at cylindrical towers with horizontal bands of lit windows at night.

assets/work/circulate-aerial.jpg.idea: This view explains the idea: a cluster of round towers sharing one base. I rendered it in flat daylight with a long shadow, like a model on an architect's table.
assets/work/circulate-aerial.jpg.alt: An aerial 3D render of a cluster of cylindrical towers on a round green base casting a long shadow.

assets/work/circulate-facade-night.jpg.idea: At night the building should read as a lantern. Three slatted towers glow from inside against flat deep blue, with a crane still on the roof.
assets/work/circulate-facade-night.jpg.alt: A 3D render of three slatted cylindrical towers lit from within against a deep blue night background.

assets/canva/liftoff-pitch-night-orbit.j.idea: A pitch is a trajectory, so the poster is one. Cream orbit rings sweep around an orange planet on navy, and the serif title sits above like a book cover.
assets/canva/liftoff-pitch-night-orbit.j.alt: Cream orbital rings curving around a large orange planet on navy, under the title Pitch Night.

assets/canva/liftoff-networking-night-de.idea: Networking is about where you are headed. A DeLorean with its doors up sits in front of a striped sunset, and arrows climb the right edge.
assets/canva/liftoff-networking-night-de.alt: A DeLorean with open gull-wing doors before a striped orange sunset, titled Networking Night.

assets/canva/curated-clothes-banner.jpg.idea: The banner frames a clothes rack as an edit. Black-and-white garment photos fan out like prints on a table, with one full outfit upright in the centre.
assets/canva/curated-clothes-banner.jpg.alt: A white banner titled Curated Clothes v1 with a fan of black-and-white clothing photos.

assets/canva/hiring-marketing.jpg.idea: The application was one image, so the poster is one. A stone head opens into a maze with a lit bulb above it and a small figure climbing the stairs in.
assets/canva/hiring-marketing.jpg.alt: A surreal stone head with a maze inside and a light bulb above, a small person climbing stairs into it, titled SIC is Hiring: Marketing.

assets/canva/billboard-how-0.jpg.idea: I asked the question at the size of a building. Five words stack down a white billboard on a brick wall, with only the logo beneath.
assets/canva/billboard-how-0.jpg.alt: A white billboard on a brick building reading How Does Startup Incubator Work?

assets/canva/billboard-times-square.jpg.idea: I put a student club's claim where the biggest brands advertise. The line runs black on white across a Times Square screen, with a silhouetted crowd along the bottom edge.
assets/canva/billboard-times-square.jpg.alt: A Times Square billboard mockup showing a Startup Incubator message in black on white above a crowd and yellow taxis.

assets/canva/dor-report-cover.jpg.idea: The report opens with the name before any number. The brush-lettered Dor mark takes the navy top half, with the title spaced wide in orange and black below.
assets/canva/dor-report-cover.jpg.alt: A report cover with a white brush-lettered logo on navy above the text Dor Foundation Annual Report 2025-26.

assets/canva/dor-report-numbers.jpg.idea: A funder should grasp the year on one page. Each figure sits in its own outlined box, with a bar chart and a donut for the splits.
assets/canva/dor-report-numbers.jpg.alt: A report page of outlined boxes with headline figures, a bar chart of admissions by course type and a donut chart.

assets/more/ai-lid-taste-has-no-class.jp.idea: The line had to flatter economy without talking down to it. A small gilt-framed portrait of the Maharaja sits on Air India red beside Taste has no class. Meal fit for a Maharaja.
assets/more/ai-lid-taste-has-no-class.jp.alt: A red Air India banner with a small framed portrait of the Maharaja and the line Taste has no class. Meal fit for a Maharaja.

assets/more/ai-storyboard-pride.jpg.idea: The film is one cut: a man doing sit-ups in a studio turns out to be reclining in his aircraft seat. The storyboard holds the same pose across both settings so the match is obvious.
assets/more/ai-storyboard-pride.jpg.alt: Storyboard frames of a man doing sit-ups in a white studio and then in an aircraft seat, ending on an Air India card.

assets/more/liftoff-card-yash.jpg.idea: This is my own card in the set. Same suit, same planet behind, and my fun fact printed on the yellow plate like a batting average.
assets/more/liftoff-card-yash.jpg.alt: A trading-card style portrait of a young man in an astronaut suit labelled Yash Kedia, VP of Marketing.

assets/more/meet-the-board-yash.jpg.idea: Each board member got a portrait with some architecture in it. An engraved classical column is drawn in white line over the concrete wall behind her.
assets/more/meet-the-board-yash.jpg.alt: A smiling woman in a black jacket before a concrete wall with a white line drawing of a classical column, labelled Jerille Delan, VP of Event Planning.

assets/more/sic-speed-networking.jpg.idea: Speed networking is going round in circles, so the title does. The words repeat in a ring around an engraved rosette, framed by corner ornaments.
assets/more/sic-speed-networking.jpg.alt: An ornamental black rosette ringed by the repeated words Speed Networking on cream, with event details.

assets/more/yc-summer-cover.jpg.idea: The cover is a guessing game. Six members appear as faded cut-outs on orange under the question Which YC startup did we work at this summer?
assets/more/yc-summer-cover.jpg.alt: An orange slide asking Which YC startup did we work at this summer? above six faded portraits.

assets/more/c16-behind-the-scenes.mp4.idea: Behind the scenes should look found, not produced. The footage sits inside a camcorder frame with a REC dot and running timecode, and yellow type stamps the time the Chancellor arrived.
assets/more/c16-behind-the-scenes.mp4.alt: Vertical hackathon footage with camcorder REC overlays, including a sticker-covered laptop and a group photo labelled 4:44 PM Chancellor Khosla.

assets/more/c16-eight-hours.mp4.idea: The day is told by the clock. Each scene gets a yellow label and an analogue clock face showing the hour, from the queue outside to judging at night, then one number on purple.
assets/more/c16-eight-hours.mp4.alt: Scenes from a hackathon day each with a yellow label and a clock, ending on a purple card reading 250+ in the room.

assets/more/c16-judges-title.mp4.idea: Announcing judges had to promise something to the entrant. A strip of four posterised portraits cycles through gold, green, blue and pink under the line and get hired in the process.
assets/more/c16-judges-title.mp4.alt: A cream poster reading Meet the c0mpiled-16 Hackathon Judges with a strip of four tinted portraits changing colour.

assets/more/c16-keyart-animated.mp4.idea: The poster needed to move without changing. The interference field behind the silhouette shifts through colour palettes while the type stays still.
assets/more/c16-keyart-animated.mp4.alt: The c0mpiled-16 hackathon poster with its central silhouette artwork cycling through different colour schemes.

assets/more/c16-prizes.mp4.idea: Prize money is shown as money. Three engraved banknotes carry the three amounts and shimmer through tints under one large serif word.
assets/more/c16-prizes.mp4.alt: A cream poster titled Hackathon Prizes with three illustrated banknotes marked 2000, 1200 and 800 changing tint.

assets/more/c16-ringdown.mp4.idea: I wanted one winning project understood in under a minute. It starts on a bar chart and the words Here's why., cuts to the team's live demo, then states the product in one typed sentence.
assets/more/c16-ringdown.mp4.alt: A purple card with bars and the words Here's why, followed by students demonstrating a project on stage with captions.

assets/more/podcast-regular-people.mp4.idea: The clip turns on one phrase, so that phrase is the only colour. It opens on a plain title card, then holds the speaker in a narrow band while just regular people lands with the last word in orange.
assets/more/podcast-regular-people.mp4.alt: An off-white title card for a conversation with Arjun Prakash, then a strip of a man speaking on black with the words just regular people.

assets/more/sic-marketing-hiring.mp4.idea: The hiring poster had to move just enough to stop a thumb. Clouds drift past the stone head and the small figure climbs the stairs toward the maze.
assets/more/sic-marketing-hiring.mp4.alt: An animated poster of a stone head with a maze inside, clouds moving and a small figure climbing stairs, titled SIC is Hiring: Marketing.

assets/more/sic-matcha-reel.mp4.idea: A fundraiser announcement works better as a prank. Someone naps in a hammock on the lawn, teammates creep up with a cooler, and the poster arrives with the line can't have him sleeping on the job.
assets/more/sic-matcha-reel.mp4.alt: People approaching someone in a hammock on a campus lawn with a cooler, ending on a Matcha Fundraiser poster.

assets/more/sic-tabling-interviews.mp4.idea: I put a chair and a mic on Library Walk and asked one question. Students answer So what's your $1 million idea? in yellow serif subtitles, and it ends on the logo.
assets/more/sic-tabling-interviews.mp4.alt: Students seated outdoors under club tents answering a question into a microphone with yellow subtitles, ending on the Startup Incubator logo.

assets/more/c16-crt-teaser.mp4.idea: A hackathon about invisible interfaces is teased on the most visible one. An old television on a VCR plays event footage in a green-lit room, then flashes text and the poster.
assets/more/c16-crt-teaser.mp4.alt: A vintage television on a VCR against a green-lit wall showing event footage, white text and the hackathon poster.

assets/more/dira-three-drapes.mp4.idea: One saree had to look like three outfits. The model drapes it three ways in the same spot, with 1st, 2nd and 3rd counted off at the top.
assets/more/dira-three-drapes.mp4.alt: A woman draping a cream and mustard saree three different ways against a peach wall, labelled 1st, 2nd and 3rd, ending on the Dira logo.

assets/more/kapoor-necklace.mp4.idea: Gold reads richest in the dark. A crescent necklace and earrings sit on green velvet and the camera circles close, with the logo last.
assets/more/kapoor-necklace.mp4.alt: A gold necklace with matching earrings on dark green velvet, ending on the Kapoor Jewellers logo.

assets/more/dor-documentary.mp4.idea: A documentary film about Dor Foundation's work, made for the foundation.

assets/deep/mussoorie-winter-line-carniv.idea: I had to make a hill town festival feel like an invitation and not a government notice. I let folk musicians and dancers walk across a real Mussoorie cloudscape under a hand-lettered title.
assets/deep/mussoorie-winter-line-carniv.alt: Brochure cover for the Mussoorie Winter Line Carnival 2023 with folk performers placed over a mountain view.

assets/deep/ssam-jagae-app-icon.jpg.idea: I had to give a handwriting app a mark that felt Korean without using a flag or a letter. I drew the pen stroke as mother-of-pearl inlay on black lacquer, the way a jagae box is made.
assets/deep/ssam-jagae-app-icon.jpg.alt: A black lacquer app icon with an iridescent mother-of-pearl emblem of a looping pen stroke over notebook lines.

assets/deep/floron-the-way-out.jpg.idea: We had to show why a cooling gas brand should care about fire exits. One stairwell sign reads IN when the building is calm and OUT when it burns.
assets/deep/floron-the-way-out.jpg.alt: A case film frame with an OUT sign in a burning stairwell and the words The Way Out.

assets/deep/dor-weaving-dreams-invite.jp.idea: I had to invite guests to our students’ send-off with the Governor as chief guest. I set it like a formal evening card in black and gold so the students’ day read as an occasion.
assets/deep/dor-weaving-dreams-invite.jp.alt: A black and gold invitation to the Weaving Dreams with Dor event on 12 August 2023 in Dehradun.

assets/deep/dor-standee-sky.jpg.idea: I had to greet guests at the door and explain what Dor does in four words. I put the four steps as line icons under an open sky.
assets/deep/dor-standee-sky.jpg.alt: A tall standee with a blue sky, the Dor logo and four icons for Understand, Reflect, Engage and Collaborate.

assets/deep/floron-cooling-gas.jpg.idea: We had to open the film on the product without a pack shot feeling like an ad break. Three cylinders stand on teal under one plain claim.
assets/deep/floron-cooling-gas.jpg.alt: Three Floron refrigerant cylinders on a teal background under the line India’s No. 1 Cooling gas.

assets/deep/air-india-tastes-like-home.j.idea: We had to sell an in-flight meal as comfort. A woman cooking at a home stove sits against Air India red with three words.
assets/deep/air-india-tastes-like-home.j.alt: A red banner with an illustrated woman in a white saree cooking and the line Tastes Like Home.

assets/deep/compiled16-two-days-left.jpg.idea: We had to count down to the hackathon without making three near identical posts. Each day gets one huge holographic numeral under the same masthead.
assets/deep/compiled16-two-days-left.jpg.alt: A cream poster for the c0mpiled-16 hackathon with a large iridescent numeral 2 and the words Days Left.

assets/deep/maple-bear-new-year.jpg.idea: I had to write a school’s New Year greeting that parents would read. It is set as the school’s own resolution with the bear mascot waving.
assets/deep/maple-bear-new-year.jpg.alt: A New Year post for Maple Bear school with gold lettering and the bear mascot.

assets/deep/itm-lohri.jpg.idea: I had to make a festival greeting for a college in its own colours. The O of Lohri becomes the institute’s green ring and the fire sits above it.
assets/deep/itm-lohri.jpg.alt: A navy Happy Lohri post for ITM with a bonfire illustration.

assets/deep/ventota-retail-logo.jpg.idea: I had to give a retail franchise company a mark of its own. V and R lock together inside an envelope-like box.
assets/deep/ventota-retail-logo.jpg.alt: A red and charcoal VR monogram in a square frame for Ventota Retail.
